UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated user's ISTQB study preferences and schedule settings.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the profile owner.

examDate.description: Optional target exam date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

startDate.description: Study plan start date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

dailyHours.description: Target study hours per day (0.5 to 12.0).

startTime.description: Preferred daily study start time in HH:mm format.

currentStreak.description: Current consecutive daily study streak count stored per user.

bestStreak.description: All-time highest consecutive daily study streak achieved by the user.

lastStudyDate.description: Most recent study activity date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server update timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

value.description: Status value (e.g., done, learning, review, saved, 1).
